xiaomi.title: Xiaomi universal remote
xiaomi.description: Choose the Xiaomi Home `remote` entity from ha_xiaomi_home, and the IR device name used when learning codes (Settings → Infrared).

data_description.xiaomi_ir_device: Must match the `device` name used with remote.learn_command, for example television.

data_description.power_binary_sensor: Select an existing binary_sensor as the real on/off state (for example a smart plug, TV power sensor, or current-clamp helper). The virtual remote follows that sensor; leave empty to keep ping, power-sensor, or optimistic state.
data_description.xiaomi_remote: The Xiaomi Home infrared remote (chuangmi.ir.v2) from ha_xiaomi_home.
data_description.xiaomi_ir_device: Must match the learned IR device name, for example television.

pwr_btn.title: Power buttons
pwr_btn.description: In Xiaomi mode, enter learned IR command names. Leave empty to use defaults (power / power).

nav_btn.title: Navigation buttons
